description_en: Queries the consumption summary for a specified billing month or billing date, and supports viewing expenses by dimensions such as billing item, resource, product, and account
description_zh: 查询用户指定账单月份或指定账单日期的消费汇总，支持按计费项、资源、产品、账号等维度查看费用
kebab_example: aliyun bssopenapi list-consume-summary --dimension-type BILLING_ITEM --common-filters '[{"Values":["ecs"],"FilterField":"ProductCode","Operation":"IN"}]' --period '{"EndTime":"2026-10-07","StartTime":"2026-10-01","Granularity":"DAILY"}' --next-token example-next-token --max-results 20 --ec-id-account-ids '[{"AccountIds":[1234567890123456],"EcId":"123456"}]' --api-version 2023-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListConsumeSummary

parameters.help_en:
The aggregation dimension.

Valid values:

`BILLING_ITEM`: aggregates by billing item. This is the default value.
`RESOURCE`: aggregates by resource.
`PRODUCT`: aggregates by product.
`ACCOUNT`: aggregates by account
parameters.help_zh:
汇总维度。

`BILLING_ITEM`：按计费项汇总，默认值；

`RESOURCE`：按资源汇总；

`PRODUCT`：按产品汇总；

`ACCOUNT`：按账号汇总
parameters.name: dimension_type

fields.help_en: The name of the filter field. For supported fields and operations, see "Common filtering" in the supplementary description of request parameters
fields.help_zh: 筛选字段名，支持字段及操作请参见请求参数补充说明中的“通用筛选”
fields.name: filter_field

fields.help_en: The operator. Default value: `IN`. `IN` indicates inclusion or exact match, `NOT` indicates exclusion, and `PREFIX` indicates prefix match. For the specific support scope, see "Common filtering" in the supplementary description of request parameters
fields.help_zh: 操作符，默认 `IN`。`IN` 为包含或精确匹配，`NOT` 为排除，`PREFIX` 为前缀匹配；具体支持范围见请求参数补充说明中的“通用筛选”
fields.name: operation

fields.help_en: Filter values always use string arrays, including single values, Boolean values, and account IDs
fields.help_zh: 筛选值始终使用字符串数组，单值、布尔值及账号 ID 也不例外
fields.name: values

parameters.help_en: The common filter conditions. Valid conditions for different fields take effect simultaneously. For supported fields and operations, see "Common filtering" in the supplementary description of request parameters
parameters.help_zh: 通用筛选条件。不同字段的有效条件同时生效，支持字段及操作见请求参数补充说明中的“通用筛选”
parameters.name: common_filters

fields.help_en:
If you query by month, only one month is supported per query. The value must be the same as the start month and formatted as `yyyy-MM`.

If you query by day, this parameter is required and formatted as `yyyy-MM-dd`. The end date cannot be earlier than the start date, and the start and end dates must be in the same month
fields.help_zh:
按月查询一次仅支持一个月份，传入时必须与开始月份相同，格式为`yyyy-MM`。

按天查询必填，格式为 `yyyy-MM-dd`，不得早于开始日期，且起止日期必须在同一个月
fields.name: end_time

fields.help_en:
The time granularity. Valid values:
`MONTHLY`: aggregates by month.
`DAILY`: aggregates by day
fields.name: granularity

fields.help_en:
If you query by month, the format is `yyyy-MM`.

If you query by day, the format is `yyyy-MM-dd`
fields.help_zh:
按月查询为 `yyyy-MM`。

按天查询为 `yyyy-MM-dd`
fields.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The query time range, which specifies the time granularity, start time, and end time
parameters.help_zh: 查询时间范围，指定时间粒度、开始时间及结束时间
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The token for the next page of query. Do not specify this parameter for the first request. For subsequent requests, pass the value returned in the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 下一页查询令牌。首次不传，后续原样传入上次响应的值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records expected to be returned per query. We recommend that you explicitly pass a positive integer. Keep this value unchanged during pagination. The actual number of returned records may be less than this value
parameters.help_zh: 单次查询期望返回的最大记录数。建议显式传入正整数；分页时保持不变，实际返回条数可能少于该值
parameters.name: max_results

fields.help_en: The list of account IDs to query. This parameter is required when an enterprise object is specified. If the entire EcIdAccountIds parameter is omitted, the data of the current calling account is queried by default
fields.help_zh: 需要查询的账号 ID 列表，传入企业对象时需填写。省略整个 EcIdAccountIds 参数时，默认查询当前调用账号的数据
fields.name: account_ids

fields.help_en: The ID of the enterprise entity
fields.name: ec_id

parameters.help_en: The query scope for enterprises and accounts. If this parameter is not specified, the default billing scope of the current calling account is used. You can specify only one enterprise object per request, and the actual scope is limited by permissions
parameters.help_zh: 企业与账号查询范围。不传时使用当前调用账号的默认账单范围；一次请求仅指定一个企业对象，实际范围受权限限制
parameters.name: ec_id_account_ids

schema.description_en: A successful response is an object where `Data` is an array of summary records. The field path `Data[].FieldName` indicates a field within an array element. The actual JSON uses the corresponding field names
schema.description_zh: 成功响应为一个对象，`Data` 为汇总记录数组。字段路径 `Data[].字段名` 表示数组元素内的字段，实际 JSON 中使用对应字段名

Data.description_en: The consumption summary records returned in this request. An empty array is returned if no matching records are found
Data.description_zh: 本次返回的消费汇总记录。无匹配记录时返回空数组

items.description_en: A single consumption summary record. It includes billing, account, product, resource, usage, price, and amount information. Whether a field is populated depends on the summary dimension, product Billable methods, and billing data
items.description_zh: 单条消费汇总记录。包含账单、账号、产品、资源、用量、价格和金额信息；字段是否有值取决于汇总维度、产品计费方式和账单数据

AmountAfterCouponDeduction.description_en: The amount after coupon deduction, which is the result of deducting coupons from the amount after discount. When all related fields are available, it equals `AmountAfterPromotionDeduction - CouponAmount`
AmountAfterCouponDeduction.description_zh: 优惠券抵扣后金额，即优惠后金额再扣除优惠券的结果。相关字段齐备时，等于 `AmountAfterPromotionDeduction - CouponAmount`

AmountAfterPromotionDeduction.description_en: The amount after discount, which represents the amount after applying official website discounts, contract discounts, and other promotions, before deducting coupons. When all related fields are available, it equals `AmountAfterSavingPlanDeduction - PromotionAmount`
AmountAfterPromotionDeduction.description_zh: 优惠后金额，表示应用官网优惠、合同折扣等优惠后的金额，此时尚未扣除优惠券。相关字段齐备时，等于 `AmountAfterSavingPlanDeduction - PromotionAmount`

AmountAfterSavingPlanDeduction.description_en: The amount after savings plan deduction, which is the remaining amount after deducting the list price portion covered by the savings plan. When all related fields are available, it equals `ListPrice - SavingPlanDeductListPrice`
AmountAfterSavingPlanDeduction.description_zh: 订阅抵扣后金额，即扣除节省计划抵扣部分的目录总价后剩余的金额。相关字段齐备时，等于 `ListPrice - SavingPlanDeductListPrice`

BillingDate.description_en: The billing date, which is the consumption date of the cloud product, in the format of yyyy-MM-dd. It has a value only when summarized by day
BillingDate.description_zh: 账单日期，即云产品的消费日期，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd；仅按天汇总时有值
BillingDate.title_en: Billing date (yyyy-MM-dd format, only for DAILY aggregation)
BillingDate.title_zh: Billing date (yyyy-MM-dd format, only for DAILY aggregation)

BillingFormula.description_en: The billing formula, which describes how the total list price is calculated. It should be understood in combination with the list price on the official website, usage, duration, and other billing factors
BillingFormula.description_zh: 计费公式，说明目录总价的计算方式，应结合官网目录价、用量、时长及其他计费因子理解
BillingFormula.example: 官网目录价 × 用量 × 时长
BillingFormula.title_en: 计费公式（对应出参 BillingFormula）
BillingFormula.title_zh: 计费公式（对应出参 BillingFormula）

BillingItemCode.description_en: The billing item code, which identifies the billing item to which the fee belongs
BillingItemCode.description_zh: 计费项 Code，标识该费用归属的计费项

BillingItemName.description_en: The billing item name, which is the display name of the billing item to which the fee belongs
BillingItemName.description_zh: 计费项名称，即该费用归属的计费项的展示名称

BillingMonth.description_en: The billing month, which represents the billing month to which the fee belongs, in the format of yyyy-MM
BillingMonth.description_zh: 账单月份，表示费用所属的账单月，格式为 yyyy-MM

BillingQuantity.description_en: The usage that is ultimately used for fee calculation. If usage deduction applies, this is the usage before deduction minus the usage deducted by resource plans, free quotas, and other deductions
BillingQuantity.description_zh: 用量，表示最终参与费用计算的用量。有用量抵扣时，为抵扣前用量减去资源包、免费额度等抵扣的用量

BillingQuantityUnit.description_en: The usage unit, used in conjunction with BillingQuantity
BillingQuantityUnit.description_zh: 用量单位，与 BillingQuantity 配合使用
BillingQuantityUnit.title_en: 用量单位（对应出参 BillingQuantityUnit）
BillingQuantityUnit.title_zh: 用量单位（对应出参 BillingQuantityUnit）

ChargeDuration.description_en: The duration, which represents the purchase or usage duration involved in billing. It has a value only when the billing formula involves time. If duration deduction applies, this is the duration before deduction minus the deducted duration
ChargeDuration.description_zh: 时长，表示参与计费的购买或使用时长，仅计费公式涉及时间时有值。有时长抵扣时，为抵扣前时长减去抵扣时长
ChargeDuration.title_en: 使用时长（对应出参 ChargeDuration）
ChargeDuration.title_zh: 使用时长（对应出参 ChargeDuration）

ChargeDurationUnit.description_en: The duration unit, used in conjunction with ChargeDuration
ChargeDurationUnit.description_zh: 时长单位，与 ChargeDuration 配合使用
ChargeDurationUnit.title_en: 时长单位（对应出参 ChargeDurationUnit）
ChargeDurationUnit.title_zh: 时长单位（对应出参 ChargeDurationUnit）

ChargeType.description_en: The billing method. Returns the display name, such as subscription or pay-as-you-go
ChargeType.description_zh: 付费类型，返回预付费、后付费等展示名称
ChargeType.title_en: 付费类型，按当前语言翻译；翻译键为 user.center.chargeType.v2.prepaid/postpaid。
ChargeType.title_zh: 付费类型，按当前语言翻译；翻译键为 user.center.chargeType.v2.prepaid/postpaid。

CommodityCode.description_en: The commodity code, used to uniquely identify a specific commodity under a cloud product
CommodityCode.description_zh: 商品 Code，用于唯一标识云产品下的具体商品

CommodityName.description_en: The commodity name, which is the display name of a specific commodity under a cloud product
CommodityName.description_zh: 商品名称，即云产品下具体商品的展示名称

ConsumeType.description_en: The transaction type, which describes the transaction behavior that generated the bill, such as new purchase, renewal, upgrade, downgrade, unsubscription, pay-as-you-go, or adjustment. Returns the display name
ConsumeType.description_zh: 交易类型，说明产生该账单的交易行为，例如新购、续订、升级、降级、退订、后付费或调账。返回展示名称

CouponAmount.description_en: The coupon deduction amount, which is the fee covered by coupons. This amount cannot be used for invoicing
CouponAmount.description_zh: 优惠券抵扣金额，即由优惠券承担的费用，该部分金额不可用于开票

Currency.description_en: The currency, which represents the currency used for the list price and amounts in this record. For example, CNY indicates Chinese Yuan
Currency.description_zh: 币种，表示本条记录的目录价及金额使用的币种，例如 CNY 表示人民币

HashKey.description_en: The summary record identifier, used as an opaque string. It can be empty
HashKey.description_zh: 汇总记录标识，作为不透明字符串使用，可为空

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID at the billing granularity, which represents the instance identity used to aggregate fees when a cloud product generates a bill. The billing granularity may differ from the resource management granularity, so it may differ from ResourceId
InstanceId.description_zh: 实例 ID（出账粒度），表示云产品生成账单时归集费用的实例标识。出账粒度可能与资源管理粒度不同，因此可能不同于 ResourceId

InstanceName.description_en: The resource name, which is the name set by the user for the cloud resource. Whether it is returned depends on whether the product supports querying and whether the resource information is available
InstanceName.description_zh: 资源名称，即用户为云资源设置的名称。是否返回取决于产品是否支持查询以及资源信息是否可获取

InstanceSpec.description_en: The specifications, used to describe the specification information corresponding to the billing item
InstanceSpec.description_zh: 规格，用于描述计费项对应的规格信息

LineItemType.description_en: The line item type, which describes the nature of the fee, such as subscription prepaid fee, subscription postpaid fee, subscription unsubscription fee, pay-as-you-go fee for cloud resources, adjustment fee, or round-down fee. Returns the display name
LineItemType.description_zh: 费用类型，说明费用的产生性质，例如订阅预付费用、订阅后付费用、订阅退订费用、云资源按量费用、调账费用或抹零费用。返回展示名称

ListPrice.description_en: The total list price, which represents the total amount calculated based on the list price for the purchased cloud resource configuration, before deducting savings plan deductions, discounts, and coupons. Note that ListPrice in this API is the total amount. For the unit list price, see ListUnitPrice
ListPrice.description_zh: 目录总价，表示所购云资源配置按目录价计算的金额合计，尚未扣除订阅抵扣、优惠和优惠券。注意本接口的 ListPrice 是总金额，目录单价见 ListUnitPrice

ListPriceUnit.description_en: The price unit, which is the unit corresponding to the list price ListUnitPrice on the official website, such as CNY/GB
ListPriceUnit.description_zh: 价格单位，即官网目录价 ListUnitPrice 对应的单位，例如元/GB

ListUnitPrice.description_en: The list price on the official website, which is the unit list price of the commodity. It differs from the total list price ListPrice. In scenarios such as tiered pricing, you cannot recalculate the fee by simply multiplying a single unit price by the total usage
ListUnitPrice.description_zh: 官网目录价，即商品的目录单价。它与目录总价 ListPrice 含义不同；阶梯定价等场景不能仅用一个单价乘以汇总用量重算费用

ProductCode.description_en: The product code, used to uniquely identify a specific cloud product
ProductCode.description_zh: 产品 Code，用于唯一标识具体云产品

ProductName.description_en: The product name, which is the display name of the cloud product
ProductName.description_zh: 产品名称，即云产品的展示名称

PromotionAmount.description_en: The discount amount, which represents the total discounts from official website promotions, contract discounts, and other offers. Coupon deductions are separately recorded in CouponAmount
PromotionAmount.description_zh: 优惠金额，表示官网优惠、合同折扣等优惠合计；优惠券抵扣单独计入 CouponAmount

PurchaseConfiguration.description_en: The configuration, used to describe the configuration options corresponding to the billing item
PurchaseConfiguration.description_zh: 选型配置，用于描述计费项对应的配置选项

RegionCode.description_en: The region code, which represents the code of the logical region where the cloud resource is located
RegionCode.description_zh: 地域 Code，表示云资源所在逻辑地域的编码

RegionName.description_en: The region, which represents the display name of the region where the cloud resource is located. For products sold by region, it usually corresponds to the region selected when placing the order
RegionName.description_zh: 地域，表示云资源所在地域的展示名称；分地域售卖的产品通常对应下单时选择的地域

RequireAmount.description_en: The payable amount, which is the fee to be paid after savings plan deductions, discounts, and coupon deductions. In the new version of bills, this corresponds to the payable amount (tax-inclusive) caliber. For fee verification, refer to the actual return value of this field
RequireAmount.description_zh: 应付金额，即完成订阅抵扣、优惠和优惠券抵扣后需要支付的费用。新版账单对应“应付金额（含税）”口径，费用核对以本字段实际返回值为准

ResourceId.description_en: The resource ID, used to uniquely identify a cloud resource in the corresponding cloud product or service
ResourceId.description_zh: 资源 ID，用于在对应云产品或服务中唯一标识云资源

ResourceOwnerAccountId.description_en: The resource ownership account ID, which is the ID of the account that actually uses the cloud resource instance. It may differ from the purchasing account
ResourceOwnerAccountId.description_zh: 资源归属账号 ID，即实际使用该云资源实例的账号 ID，可能与购买账号不同

ResourceOwnerAccountName.description_en: The resource ownership account, which is the name of the account that actually uses the cloud resource instance. It may differ from the purchasing account
ResourceOwnerAccountName.description_zh: 资源归属账号，即实际使用该云资源实例的账号名称，可能与购买账号不同

ResourcePurchaseAccountId.description_en: The resource purchasing account ID, which is the ID of the account that placed the order to purchase the cloud resource instance
ResourcePurchaseAccountId.description_zh: 资源购买账号 ID，即下单购买该云资源实例的账号 ID
ResourcePurchaseAccountId.title_en: Resource purchase account ID (user account ID)
ResourcePurchaseAccountId.title_zh: Resource purchase account ID (user account ID)

ResourcePurchaseAccountName.description_en: The resource purchasing account, which is the name of the account that placed the order to purchase the cloud resource instance
ResourcePurchaseAccountName.description_zh: 资源购买账号，即下单购买该云资源实例的账号名称

SavingPlanDeductAmount.description_en: The savings plan deduction amount, which is the committed spend of the savings plan consumed to complete this deduction. It is not the list price amount of the deducted resource and cannot replace SavingPlanDeductListPrice for deduction from the total list price
SavingPlanDeductAmount.description_zh: 订阅抵扣金额，即完成本次抵扣所消耗的节省计划承付款金额。它不是被抵扣资源的目录价金额，不能代替 SavingPlanDeductListPrice 从目录总价中扣减

SavingPlanDeductListPrice.description_en: The savings plan deduction list price, which is the amount calculated based on the list price for the pay-as-you-go resource fees deducted by the savings plan
SavingPlanDeductListPrice.description_zh: 订阅抵扣目录总价，即节省计划抵扣掉的按量资源费用按目录价计算的金额
SavingPlanDeductListPrice.title_en: Saving plan deduct list price (SPN deduct original amount)
SavingPlanDeductListPrice.title_zh: Saving plan deduct list price (SPN deduct original amount)

ServiceEntity.description_en: The service entity, which is the name of the company that actually provides the product or service. Different products may correspond to different companies
ServiceEntity.description_zh: 服务主体，实际提供该产品或服务的公司名称，不同产品可能对应不同公司

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of records per page used in this query
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次查询使用的每页最大记录数
MaxResults.title_en: 单次查询的最大记录数
MaxResults.title_zh: 单次查询的最大记录数

NextToken.description_en: The query token for the next page. If a non-empty value is returned, pass it as-is in the next request and keep other query conditions unchanged. If it is not returned or is empty, pagination ends
NextToken.description_zh: 下一页查询令牌。返回非空值时，原样传入下一次请求，并保持其他查询条件不变；未返回或为空时结束翻页
NextToken.title_en: 下一个查询开始Token，NextToken为空说明没有下一个
NextToken.title_zh: 下一个查询开始Token，NextToken为空说明没有下一个

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of this request, used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于定位问题
